tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of th enational museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in teh Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
